videos.name: real_01
videos.note: Hardware reorientation run with HUD: goal and current cube, distance to goal (deg) vs time (s), SO(3) trajectory. run_20260911_231047_goal01. Not real time throughout: the first ~15 s of the clip cover ~26 s on the HUD clock (about 1.75x); after that it runs at real time. Overall the 45.8 s clip covers ~56 s, so a playbackRate badge understates the true speed-up.
